notes: Real: in 1994 Thomas Nicely of Lynchburg College found the Pentium division flaw while computing Brun's constant and reported it to Intel on 24 October 1994 (Wikipedia 'Pentium FDIV bug'). The bug is known, but its origin in a twin-prime computation is an obscure detail.
